svg.title: Hackathons & Contests
svg.desc: Hackathons and contests: ICPC Vietnam Honorable Mention x2 (National and Southern Provincial 2025), Google Hackathon on Campus Top 4; also competed in Bach Khoa Code Challenge #3, Zalo AI Challenge 2026, DENSO Hackathon 2026, RMIT Hackathon 2026, SEAL Hackathon 2026, Swinburne Hackathon 2026, MoMo Hackathon, NVIDIA Jetson AI Racer 2026, IT Consultant Challenge 2026, FPT Talent Code Contest.
